in_sanskrit.name: Chinmayee
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chinmayee is derived from the Sanskrit word Chinmaya, which is composed of two roots: Chin meaning consciousness or intelligence, and Maya meaning illusion or magic. Together, the name Chinmayee can be interpreted as Consciousness is an illusion or Illusion is consciousness.
